scripts.dev: npm run build -w @freedomstream/contracts && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @freedomstream/server" "npm run dev -w @freedomstream/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @freedomstream/contracts && npm run build -w @freedomstream/server && npm run build -w @freedomstream/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @freedomstream/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build -w @freedomstream/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/relay-config.test.mjs scripts/production-config.test.mjs scripts/discord-commands.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
